theorem singletonTensorCech_coface_raw_projection
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (s : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n) :
    let G := (Over.forget U).op ⋙
      (((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)
    let P := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g)
    let Q := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)
    let f := Pi.lift (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g) (j.succAbove k))
    Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) → Fin 1 ↦ G.obj (op P)) (fun _ ↦ 0)
        ((singletonTensorCechCosimplicial X F U W g).δ j s) =
      G.map f.op (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1 ↦ G.obj (op Q)) (fun _ ↦ 0) s)

proof.text: Unfold CosimplicialObject.δ and FormalCoproduct.cosimplicialObjectFunctor_obj_map for an arbitrary presheaf on Over U. Apply Mathlib Pi.lift_π_apply. The tuple obtained by precomposing the constant-zero tuple with j.succAbove is again constant zero, and the component arrow is definitionally Pi.lift of the retained projections. Specialize this proved private calculation to the lifted tensor-section presheaf.
